name: pdfluent
description: PDFluent plugins for Claude Code: read, search and fill local PDFs, or call the hosted API.

plugins.name: pdfluent
plugins.description: Read, search and fill local PDFs as markdown, text, tables and form fields. Runs on your machine; your documents are never uploaded.

plugins.name: pdfluent-hosted
plugins.description: PDFluent hosted API as MCP tools: PDF to markdown and tables, PDF operations and conversions. Needs a PDFLUENT_API_KEY; calls are paid in credits.
